about.title: About XCAfrique
about.missionText1: XCAfrique is a professional media dedicated to African aviation news. Our ambition is to provide reliable, verified and contextualized information on the entire air sector of the continent.
about.missionText2: In an environment where information circulates quickly, sometimes incompletely or unverified, XCAfrique positions itself as a reference platform for aviation professionals, enthusiasts and all those who follow the evolution of air transport in Africa.
about.missionText3: We cover a wide range of topics: airline news, safety and regulation, airport infrastructure, training, innovation, African market, sustainable development and sector analysis.
about.missionText4: Our approach is based on three pillars: rigor, transparency and systematic fact-checking. We prioritize clear, documented and useful information, designed to support the growth of a strategic sector.
about.founderBio1: Graduated with a master's degree in communication and public relations, she worked for several years as Commercial Flight Personnel, an experience that gave her concrete knowledge of air operations, security and internal realities of air transport.
about.founderBio2: Passionate about aviation and reliable information production, she has also collaborated as a web editor, developing a clear, precise and documented style. Her field of expertise covers aeronautical news, safety, innovation, airlines, passenger experience and the evolution of sector professions.
about.founderBio3: Convinced of the importance of a serious and rigorous media to support the development of air transport in Africa, she founded XCAfrique, a platform dedicated to analysis, verification and dissemination of reliable aeronautical information. Through XCAfrique, she defends factual, structured and transparent information.
about.reliabilityText: Every piece of information is verified and cross-checked with multiple sources before publication.
about.professionalismText: Rigorous and in-depth coverage of African aviation news.
about.independenceText: An independent and objective editorial approach, without external influence.
